auto_enabled_status.desc: Filter by org deployment, independently of publication. Use `category`, `creator_ids`, `publish_status`, and `auto_enabled_status` to filter.

category.desc: Only return skills in this category. _Acceptable values:_ `communication` `customer_support` `data_and_analytics` `engineering` `product_management` `productivity` `professional_development` `project_management` `sales` `system` `team_management` `other`. Use `category`, `creator_ids`, `publish_status`, and `auto_enabled_status` to filter.

creator_ids.desc: Only return skills created by these users. Accepts U or W user IDs. _Maximum:_ `100`. Use `category`, `creator_ids`, `publish_status`, and `auto_enabled_status` to filter.

cursor.desc: Continuation from the previous page. Keep all filters and sorting unchanged. Pages can be empty while a continuation remains; continue until next\_cursor is empty. Changes during traversal may move results; pagination is not a snapshot.

limit.desc: The maximum number of skills to return. Fewer may be returned even when more remain.

publish_status.desc: Filter by publication to the org catalog. Use `category`, `creator_ids`, `publish_status`, and `auto_enabled_status` to filter.

sort.desc: Sort across the inventory. Name uses case-insensitive ordering. Unedited skills use their creation date for date\_updated sorting. Use `sort` (`name`, `usage_count`, or `date_updated`) and `sort_dir` (`asc` or `desc`) to order the inventory.

sort_dir.desc: Sort direction; file ID breaks ties. Use `sort` (`name`, `usage_count`, or `date_updated`) and `sort_dir` (`asc` or `desc`) to order the inventory.

desc: Lists metadata for skills owned by the organization, including invite-only skills.

errors.feature_not_enabled: The Skills API isn't enabled for this organization or workspace.
errors.invalid_category: The category isn't one of the supported skill categories.
errors.invalid_cursor: The cursor is malformed or belongs to different filters, sorting, user, or organization.
errors.restricted_action: The caller must be an org admin or owner with permission to manage skills.
